Package com.privatechain.core.network

Interface NodeServerLifecycle

All Known Implementing Classes:
NodeServer
public interface NodeServerLifecycle
Lifecycle interface for the P2P TCP node server.

Defined in blockchain-core so that BlockchainNode can control the server lifecycle without a hard dependency on the blockchain-network module or Netty (design.md §7.1 — dependency inversion principle).

The concrete NodeServer implementation lives in blockchain-network and is injected via BlockchainNode.setNodeServer(NodeServerLifecycle) during node assembly.

Since:
1.0.0

      In-flight connections are closed gracefully where possible. After this call, isRunning() returns false.
